content.comment_body: I managed to download [product_name] Comfort [version_no] upgrade patches, but not the main [version_no]. The [company_name] support was unhelpful; they didn't have the main setup files. They spent the whole day sharing patch files without realizing the main version was required first, as written in the patch notes. Very disappointed in [company_name].

The files you found are only upgrades, not the complete installer. You need to buy the full version first. If you already have any previous full version, you can apply the update. Even if you have an older version on CD or DVD, updates can be installed. Refer to this FAQ for details: How do you install a downloaded upgrade for [product_name] with or without the main software?
Wish your support staff had clarified that. So to communicate with the device, I must purchase the [product_name]? What is the cost?

As I've mentioned and as detailed in the FAQ: Any full version suffices, such as one on CD or DVD, e.g., [product_name] V6.x, V7.x, or V8.x. No extra license key is necessary, unlike some other [product_name]. Full versions are available on online marketplaces like Ebay and Amazon. Prices vary by seller.
Could you please share a link to a reputable seller? I can't seem to find reliable results.
Which country are you from? I am based in Germany, so providing an Amazon Germany link may not help if you're elsewhere.

I live in India. When I search, I only see localized results, and nothing relevant to the software. Please share the Amazon Germany link; it would help me know what keywords to use. If it’s not available locally, I can order from Germany.
[url] Where did you purchase your [product_name]? The seller typically offers the software as well.
Perhaps the order number can assist you: [article_no]. The listed price in Germany is EUR 50 plus tax, which would be around INR 4000 in India if the pricing matches. Regards, [user_name]
Thanks, this information is very helpful!

analysis.insight_summary: The user’s main frustration was not being able to find and directly download the complete installer for [product_name] V8.0 from [company_name]'s official sources, only upgrade patches were available. It took considerable time before realizing the need for the main version, and there was a lack of clear communication from the support team. Community members provided useful details about purchase options, update processes, and price differences depending on region.
analysis.user_expectations: User wishes for a more straightforward approach to obtaining the primary installer for [product_name], preferably accessible without confusion or delay. Clear and concise guidance from support on how to acquire the software is expected.
